description: Points de stationnement des deux roues non-motorisés is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by EPT Plaine Commune. This map lists all bicycle parking points (non-motorized two-wheelers) on the territory of Plaine Commune (bicycle racks). It shall contain the following information: Location of the parking point (Commune et Voies), capacity, type of furniture, mode of access to the location, coverage (rain protection, etc.), coordinates X,Y. Coverage: EPT Plaine Commune. The portal shows the English title as "Parking points for two non-motorized wheels" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is EPT Plaine Commune. Its keywords include cyclable, stationnement, mobilite, plaine-commune, stationnement-cyclable, mobilite-douce. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, XLSX. The listing shows 2025-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
